notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for RTIambassador::setRangeBounds and its successful HLAreportServiceInvocation delivery through the standard MIM. The region range operation maps to clause 9.1.2; successful service invocation reporting and interaction content map to clauses 11.5 and 11.5.1. The scenario establishes a valid one-dimension region range with reporting disabled, enables MOM reporting, calls SetRangeBounds once, and checks the exact supplied Region/Dimension handles and lower/upper values, standard null return marker, success and empty-exception fields, serial zero, region service type 5, reliable delivery, and inherited HLAfederate reporter identity. It does not assert failed-service report payloads, file-report behavior, or region-based routing. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard 1516.2 MIM data elements, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM and configured dimension, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration.

api_surfaces.owner: IEEE 1516.1 C++ API and IEEE 1516.2 standard MIM
api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador::createRegion(DimensionHandleSet), RTIambassador::setRangeBounds(RegionHandle, DimensionHandle, RangeBounds), RTIambassador::commitRegionModifications(RegionHandleSet), RTIambassador::setServiceReportingSwitch(Boolean), and FederateAmbassador::receiveInteraction for HLAreportServiceInvocation
